Zach Sharpe at PAPA 20 World Pinball Championship

strategy.summary: Complete S-K-A-T-E twice. Stop before B-A-L-L completes. Then repeat the 100,000 right saucer and collect a large bonus there.

steps.text: Test the right-saucer kickout. Also test the reversed left lanes and the reverse-direction lane change.
modeNotes: Right-saucer kickout: Each copy can feed differently. Hold the upper flipper, hold then drop it, let the ball roll, or flip at S-K-A-T-E. Use the first safe result.
Left lanes: The return lane and outlane are opposite the usual positions.

steps.text: From the right flipper, complete S-K-A-T-E once for a 50,000 saucer. Complete it a second time for a 100,000 saucer.
modeNotes: Right saucer value: It starts at 20,000. S-K-A-T-E completions raise it to 50,000, then 100,000.
Each S-K-A-T-E completion also adds base bonus.

steps.text: Do not complete S-K-A-T-E a third time. Transfer to the left flipper and shoot the right saucer for 100,000.
modeNotes: B-A-L-L: The third S-K-A-T-E completion finishes B-A-L-L and lights an extra ball at the saucer. Collecting it resets the repeatable saucer value.
Tournament extra balls are usually disabled or converted. Keep the 100,000 saucer instead.

steps.text: Use the controlled kickout to regain the right flipper. Transfer back to the left flipper and repeat the 100,000 saucer.
Advance Bonus X with the 1-2-3 top lanes or the upper-left arrow bank while its green X lamp is on.
modeNotes: Bonus X: It reaches 5x. It carries between balls only when that operator setting is enabled.
Base bonus: It reaches 70,000. Reaching 20,000, 40,000, or 60,000 establishes that Super Bonus checkpoint as the starting base on later balls.

steps.text: When base bonus is large, complete the flashing upper-left arrow bank. Then shoot the right saucer to collect bonus.
modeNotes: Collect Bonus: The lit saucer scores base bonus times Bonus X. It does not reset either value.
Do not enable or collect it early when direct upper-bank hits are not worth the risk.

fallback.title: Bonus first
fallback.when: Use this when the saucer value resets, the saucer shot rejects, or its kickout is not controlled.

steps.text: Use the spinner and top 1-2-3 lanes to advance base bonus and Bonus X.
Use the upper-left flipper for the arrow bank. Avoid lower-flipper shots at that bank until the bonus is large.
Complete the flashing upper-left arrow bank to light Collect Bonus, then take one valuable saucer collect when its return is acceptable.

alternatives.title: Third S-K-A-T-E completion
alternatives.when: Use this only when the event gives useful points for the extra ball or when the repeatable 100,000 saucer is not available.

steps.text: Complete S-K-A-T-E a third time to finish B-A-L-L.
Collect the lit extra ball or point award at the saucer.
Keep the saucer at 100,000 by stopping after two S-K-A-T-E completions.

Knock down drop targets, enter the saucer, roll over lit side buttons, and complete the top lanes until base bonus reaches 70,000. Complete 1-2-3 or the green-X upper-left bank until Bonus X reaches 5x; do not assume it carries unless the setting is enabled.
Complete the flashing upper-left arrow bank to light Collect Bonus, then shoot the saucer for up to 350,000 without resetting the bonus.

techniques.name: Backhand
techniques.instruction: Test a right-flipper backhand to the right saucer. Use it only when it is safer than transferring to the left flipper.

techniques.name: Post pass
techniques.instruction: Move the ball from the right flipper to the left flipper. Then shoot the right saucer with a forehand.

techniques.name: Hold-and-drop kickout control
techniques.instruction: Hold the upper flipper as the saucer ejects. Drop it as the ball reaches the flipper if that produces the safe feed on this copy.

cautions.issue: The right-saucer kickout can feed the right outlane, a sling, or the center.
cautions.response: Test hold, hold-and-drop, and no-flip returns. Use the most repeatable result before you loop the saucer.

cautions.issue: The center three-bank is high risk and has little strategic value.
cautions.response: Do not shoot it. Use S-K-A-T-E, the saucer, the spinner, and the upper-left bank.

cautions.issue: Bumper exits and direct upper-bank or S-K-A-T-E rebounds can drain.
cautions.response: Use the upper-left flipper for the upper bank. Prefer lower-flipper S-K-A-T-E shots over the upper-right-flipper angle.

quickInfo.name: Long goal
quickInfo.summary: Keep the saucer at 100,000 by stopping after two S-K-A-T-E completions.

quickInfo.name: Safer fallback
quickInfo.summary: Bonus first: Use this when the saucer value resets, the saucer shot rejects, or its kickout is not controlled.

checkBeforePlay: Confirm Bally Skateball, ball count, Bonus X carry, and award conversions.
Test the saucer, both banks, lane change, and upper-playfield feeds.
strategy.simpleOverview: In Skateball, two S-K-A-T-E completions raise the right saucer from 20,000 to 100,000, but a third completion finishes B-A-L-L and resets that value after its award. Stop after two sets and repeat the 100,000 saucer. When bonus is large, complete the flashing upper-left arrow bank and return to the saucer to collect base bonus times Bonus X.
strategy.overview: In Skateball, completing S-K-A-T-E twice raises the right saucer to a repeatable 100,000, while a third completion finishes B-A-L-L and resets the saucer after its extra-ball award. Stop after two sets, control the kickout, and repeat the saucer. Build Bonus X through the top lanes or the upper-left arrow bank, then complete that bank while its green X lamp is on and shoot the saucer for the multiplied Bonus Collect.
